from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
program_text='''def transform(grid):\n    height = len(grid)\n    output = []\n    for y in range(3 * height):\n        block, row_offset = divmod(y, height)\n        source_row = height - 1 - row_offset if block in (0, 2) else row_offset\n        row = list(grid[source_row])\n        output.append(row[::-1] + row)\n    return output\n'''
path=programs/'task-24c6d316.py'
path.write_text(program_text)
exec(compile(program_text,str(path),'exec'),globals())
transform1=transform
